sentences.text:
On The 15 th Of July, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 28211 of 2024
 Hafiz Mohammad @ Asif Khan
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Anirudh K. Mishra - Advocate for the applicant.
Shri Atmaram Ben - Dy. Govt. Advocate for respondent No.1/

Order 
This is second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.92/2024, dated 06.3.2024 registered at Police Station- Khimlasa,
District-Sagar (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Sections 5/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Applicant is in detention since 18.3.2024.

2. Applicant's first bail application was dismissed as withdrawn and not pressed vide order dated 24.4.2024 passed in M.Cr.C. No.14453/2024 with liberty to renew the prayer for grant of bail after prosecutrix's evidence before the trial Court.
3. As per the prosecution story, on 06.3.2024, 16 years and six months old prosecutrix's father informed Police about missing of his daughter since 7 P.M. of the night.
When despite search she could not be traced, FIR was lodged.
On 09.3.2024, minor prosecutrix was recovered and after investigation, charge sheet was filed for commission of aforesaid offence.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.

Prosecutrix, who is major,
was a consenting party.
It is further submitted that prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial Court and she has not supported the prosecution story.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.

5 . O n the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for grant of bail to the Hafiz Mohammad @ Asif Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75629304/
1 applicant.
6 .

entities.text: Hafiz Mohammad @ Asif Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: I n this case, prosecutrix has already been examined before the trial Court.
She has not supported the prosecution story.
Now, there is no possibility of influencing of prosecution witnesses and tampering with the prosecution evidence.

Therefore, having taken into consideration the detention period of the applicant, but without expressing anything on the merits of the case, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pre-trial detention of the applicant is not warranted.

Consequently,
this bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

7 . It is directed that applicant - Hafiz Mohammad @ Asif Khan be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
8 .
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case o f bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become 3 MCRC-28211-2024 ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE mrs. mishra Hafiz Mohammad @ Asif Khan vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 15 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/75629304/
